title: Nharaunda yeChivi Chekutanga
intro: Munyika yemaguta ekare, vanhu vaimbobudirira. Vaishanyirwa nemutumwa ane chikumbiro chakajeka, asi vakatendeuka ndokutevera nzira isina kumbobvira yafamba nemunhu. Nyaya yavo ndeyekusateerera, kuipa, uye chirango chakasiya nyika yavo sechiratidzo kune vese vanofungisisa. Mweya iyi ndivanaani?
clues: Taigara mumaguta ebani, uko muporofita wedu akatidana kuti tive vakarurama.
Isu takanga tiri vekutanga kuita chinhu chisina kunaka chakamboitwa nemunhu pasi rose.
Tairamba vafambi uye takaita zvakaipa pachena pamisangano yedu.
Takaramba nhume yatakatumwa nayo uye takatyisidzira kuidzinga munyika yedu.
Takamhanyira kumba kwake tichimukumbira kuti atipe vaenzi vake.
Chirango chedu chaive mvura yematombo, uye guta redu rakaparadzwa.
verse: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger. (26:162)
